title: Offers Christmas gift, considers breakup with Hirata, requests assurance of utility/protection, reacts to firs
observed_actions: Offers Christmas gift, considers breakup with Hirata, requests assurance of utility/protection, reacts to first-name reciprocity and accepts cold medicine.
observed_result: Reavalia vínculo com Hirata, oferece presente e negocia proteção; mudança relacional concreta, não término já consumado.
epistemic_limits: Changes protective cover, reciprocity and intimacy without official romantic label.
counterfactual_test: Do not force the same choice, attachment, defeat or cooperation after divergent history
